gen-gf-tektur-gf-anaheim: Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with wide-open curve endings. Anaheim, a sans, packs its rounded lowercase into a tight huddle, so a larger heading and a smaller body size would let the two sit comfortably.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-arsenal: Arsenal packs its tall lowercase into a close-knit string with only a slight weight shift. Over a long passage that gives a sturdy, steady texture, while Tektur's pencil-line headings stay stark above it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-arsenal-sc: Faint thick-thin shifts and tight spacing give this sans-serif a quiet, tidy texture. Arsenal SC carries that moderate modulation under Tektur's marker-plain headings, which are drawn with no variation at all.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-asimovian: Tall lowercase letters built from one stroke width make this sans-serif plain to read. Asimovian then sits under Tektur, whose pipe-cleaner curves and oversized lowercase supply all the personality.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-basic: Pipe-cleaner strokes, a constant stripe of ink with wide-open curve endings, give Tektur its odd, engineered look. Basic, a sans-serif, rises gently from small letters to capitals and reads smoothly.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-cal-sans: Tektur's outsized lowercase and open curve endings make its headings instantly recognizable. And Cal Sans, a plain sans with one stroke width, short ascenders and a tall x-height, keeps longer text steady and friendly.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-carlito: Carlito reads tight and clear, like thread wound on a spool, with small-looking capitals beside big lowercase. Tektur earns its keep big and short, where its pipe-cleaner curves can show off.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-changa: Changa stands tall, its lowercase built like cast iron capitals. Changa keeps a longer stretch of text weighty and clean, a plain sans foil to Tektur's thin-looking pipe-cleaner strokes.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-courier-prime: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase make its headings look machined yet playful. And Courier Prime, a monospace, answers with a steady drafting-pen line and generous round letters that feel precise.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-days-one: Days One fills the line with its tall x-height, spaced like rungs on a rope ladder. And its sturdy sans-serif rhythm makes a longer stretch feel dense but friendly under Tektur's wiry headings.
